ratio_cause: Finite negative bound distance divided by finite negative subnormal movement overflows positively; old primal ratio rejects any nonfinite result.
ratio_change: Retain a positive overflowing ratio as a bound candidate so another finite blocker can win. Reject a nonfinite winning step; no unbounded certificate from overflow alone. Invalid numerator or movement and negative overflow remain inconclusive.
precisions: Float32/64 and BigFloat paths; rational path retains ordinary semantics. No tolerance, arithmetic precision or coefficient changes.

verification.review: Independent read-only review: no actionable correctness finding; overflow/unbounded distinction, Harris pass, BigFloat and entering width reviewed.
verification.full_project_suite: 900-second timeout during LLVM compilation at test/legacy_primal_point_recovery_tests.jl:48; no suite summary. The attempt began with production-master source before the ratio edit.

work_and_memory_review.ordinary_work: One additional scalar finite check after the existing row scan. Existing per-row finite check retained. No new vector/matrix scan, solve, copy, conversion, cache or retained storage.
work_and_memory_review.overflow_only_work: One repeated distance subtraction and scalar predicates; BigFloat may allocate one temporary subtraction result.
work_and_memory_review.scaling: Existing O(number of basic rows) passes; unchanged dependence on basis update chain.
work_and_memory_review.measurement: 7 alternating paired samples, Float32/64, 64 and4096 basic rows, sparse/dense columns; compilation and fixture initialization excluded.
work_and_memory_review.allocation_result: Same1/2events and16/32bytes per measured batch before/after, not per call; no new per-call allocation observed.
work_and_memory_review.conclusion: No unnecessary material computation or retained memory found. Small timing differences under concurrent validation do not establish a speedup.

limitations: Full project suite remains incomplete. Ratio fix has direct coverage from the original ARM handoff and26227focused semantic checks, not a complete ARM solve from MPS. The full Intel solve with both integrated fixes passes but does not prove positive ratio overflow was exercised.
